title.en: Financial Services and Markets (Information Sharing Scheme for Prescribed Financial Institutions) Regulations 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Financial Services and Markets (Information Sharing Scheme for Prescribed Financial Institutions) Regulations 2024 and come into operation on 1 April 2024.
